completion:
# Before you begin

Whether you’ve developed test records from scratch, or you are documenting failed test results from an existing report, you need to create one test report that has everything you need. Here we will go over the steps you need to follow in order to create a comprehensive product performance report.

1. Start with the test records

You have many options for adding records to a test report. For example, if you don’t want to add all the copies of your existing test records, you can reduce the number of copies required by putting individual units on separate tables. For example, if your sample is 4 samples of 20ml units in 1kg containers, you can code these as “4×1kg containers”. You can then code the 4 tests that you wish to perform on each item. In addition to this you can reduce the amount of energy that your test uses by using the following settings:

1
